translations.name: Central Jersey Legal Services
translations.description: Central Jersey Legal Services helps people in Mercer, Middlesex and Union counties. Your income and assets are screened by phone with no documents (250% of the poverty level). Anyone 60 or older gets advice regardless of income. Call Mercer 609-695-6249, Middlesex 732-249-7600 or Union 908-354-4340.
translations.website_description: Learn about free or low-cost legal help.
